title: p-Terphenyls from the Fruiting Bodies of Boletopsis leucomelas with Neuroprotective, Anti-Neuroinflammatory, and Antioxidant Activities.
authors: Le, Tam Thi; Tran, Son Hung; Lee, Sohyun; Ko, Hyejin; Cha, Jin Wook; Park, Jin-Soo; Nguyen, Hai Yen; Kim, Won Kyu; Kang, Kyungsu; Jung, Sang Hoon
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蘑菇中p-Terphenyls化合物的神经保护与抗炎活性，涉及NF-kappaB/Nrf2通路和分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Boletopsis leucomelasis a widely consumed edible mushroom with a dark-gray fruiting body. Four new p-terphenyls (1-4, boletamins A-D), one previously reported compound without detailed characterization (5, boletamin E), and seven known compounds (6-12) were isolated from its fruiting body and structurally elucidated via NMR and HRESIMS. Among them, compounds 2 and 3 (boletamins B and C) exhibited significant anti-neuroinflammatory, neuroprotective, and antioxidant activities in BV2 microglial and HT22 neuronal cells. Mechanistically, these dual effects were associated with the modulation of the NF-kappaB/COX-2 and Keap1/Nrf2 signaling pathways, as demonstrated through network pharmacology analysis, molecular docking studies, and experimental verification. Compounds 2 and 3 also effectively restored neuronal dysfunction and suppressed the intracellular ROS production in the in vivo Caenorhabditis elegans model induced by Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1, without causing toxicity. These findings position boletamins B and C as promising leads for the development of neuroprotective functional foods or nutraceuticals.
abstract_zh: Boletopsis leucomelas是一种广泛食用的食用菌，具有深灰色子实体。从其子实体中分离出四种新的对三联苯类化合物（1-4，boletamins A-D）、一种先前报道但未详细表征的化合物（5，boletamin E）以及七种已知化合物（6-12），并通过核磁共振（NMR）和高分辨质谱（HRESIMS）对其结构进行了阐明。其中，化合物2和3（boletamins B和C）在BV2小胶质细胞和HT22神经元细胞中表现出显著的抗神经炎症、神经保护和抗氧化活性。机制上，这些双重效应与NF-kappaB/COX-2和Keap1/Nrf2信号通路的调节相关，这一点通过网络药理学分析、分子对接研究和实验验证得以证实。化合物2和3在体内秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）模型中，由铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）PAO1诱导的条件下，也有效恢复了神经元功能障碍并抑制了细胞内活性氧（ROS）的产生，且未引起毒性。这些发现将boletamins B和C定位为开发神经保护功能食品或营养保健品的潜在先导化合物。
